topLeftCell.description: Top-left visible cell; round-trip only meaningful when scrolled

zoomScalePageLayoutView.description: Zoom scale for page layout view

zoomScaleSheetLayoutView.description: Zoom scale for sheet layout view

dxfId.description: Differential format id for cell/font-color sorts

namespaces.description: Namespace declarations carried on the ext element (xmlns:x14="…") — the prefixed children are unbound without them.

SupplementalFontOptions.description: Supplemental font for a script range.

thickness.description: Surface thickness — plain number or percentage string ("N%").

lastClr.description: Last known RGB color value (optional fallback)

rgb.description: Hex ARGB color string with alpha, e.g. "FF4472C4" (passed through verbatim)

position.description: a:tab `@pos` — tab stop position in EMU.

calculatedColumnFormulaArray.description: Whether calculated column formula is array

totalsRowFormulaArray.description: Whether totals row formula is array

totalsRowLabel.description: Totals row label (used when totalsRowFunction is "none" or "custom")

uniqueName.description: Unique column name for structured references

autoFilter.description: Auto-filter (ref shorthand or structured filter columns/sort state)

headerRowBorderDxfId.description: Header row border differential format index

id.description: Unique table id (1-based, must be unique across the workbook)

totalsRowBorderDxfId.description: Totals row border differential format index

totalsRowShown.description: Whether to show totals row (default: true when totalsRowCount > 0)

TableType.description: Table source kind: "worksheet", "xml" external XML mapping, "queryTable" query result.

TextAlignment.description: Paragraph alignment; "justify" stretches lines to full width.

paragraphs.description: Paragraph list; string entries expand to a one-run paragraph.

text.description: Single-paragraph shorthand; expands to one paragraph on stringify.

break.description: Marks a soft line break (a:br) within a paragraph's children.

baseline.description: Baseline offset as integer percent (positive = superscript, negative = subscript).

outline.description: a:ln. `true` emits a sane default; a full OutlineOptions round-trips.

shadow.description: a:effectLst (EG_EffectProperties). `true` emits a default outer shadow; a full EffectListOptions round-trips.

size.description: Font size in points. Serialized as OOXML a:sz (hundredths of a point).

smtClean.description: `@smtClean` — smart tag clean flag (XSD default true).

underlineFill.description: EG_TextUnderlineFill — underline fill. `true` = a:uFillTx (follow the text fill); a FillOptions = a:uFill.

underlineLine.description: EG_TextUnderlineLine — underline line. `true` = a:uLnTx (follow the text line); an OutlineOptions = a:uLn.

text.description: a:t — display text (often a placeholder such as "‹#›" or "1/27/13").

TextFont.description: A script typeface. A bare string is the typeface only; the full object carries panose/pitchFamily/charset for embedded font metrics.

TextFontOptions.description: Single font slot — a:latin / a:ea / a:cs / a:sym.

referenceId.description: Internal placeholder key ("{hlink:N}" → "N"); preserved across parse → stringify.

slide.description:

url.description: External URL target (mutually exclusive with slide).

TextListStyleOptions.description: A bare — a:defPPr plus up to 9 outline levels. The shape of a:lstStyle inside a txBody, p:notesStyle, and p:defaultTextStyle.

defaultParagraph.description: a:defPPr — defaults applied before any level.

ext.description: Trailing a:extLst verbatim inner XML; `""` preserves a bare <a:extLst/>.

levels.description: Levels 1-9; index 0 = lvl1pPr. `null` omits the level (JSON form of an undefined array slot — the position still pins the level number).

defaultRunProperties.description: a:defRPr — default run properties for the paragraph.

ext.description: Verbatim inner XML of a:extLst (last child per).

lineSpacingPercent.description: Line spacing as a percentage (100 = single).

spaceAfter.description: Space after a paragraph in points (a:spcAft/a:spcPts).

spaceAfterPercent.description: Space after a paragraph as a percentage (a:spcAft/a:spcPct).

spaceBefore.description: Space before a paragraph in points (a:spcBef/a:spcPts).

spaceBeforePercent.description: Space before a paragraph as a percentage (a:spcBef/a:spcPct).

tabStops.description: a:tabLst — explicit tab stops (emitted after bullets, before defRPr).

baseline.description: Baseline offset as integer percent (positive = superscript, negative = subscript).

emptyProperties.description: The source carried a bare `<a:rPr/>` with no attributes or children. Round-trip marker only — re-emits the empty element instead of dropping it (element presence is part of the source's fidelity).

outline.description: a:ln. `true` emits a sane default; a full OutlineOptions round-trips.

shadow.description: a:effectLst (EG_EffectProperties). `true` emits a default outer shadow; a full EffectListOptions round-trips.

size.description: Font size in points. Serialized as OOXML a:sz (hundredths of a point).

underlineFill.description: EG_TextUnderlineFill — underline fill. `true` = a:uFillTx (follow the text fill); a FillOptions = a:uFill.

underlineLine.description: EG_TextUnderlineLine — underline line. `true` = a:uLnTx (follow the text line); an OutlineOptions = a:uLn.

Tile alignment within the shape.

Specifies the anchor position of the first tile relative to the shape.

Tile flip mode for tiling images.

Specifies whether the image is flipped along the x-axis, y-axis, both axes, or not at all when tiling.

TileOptions.description:

Configures how an image is tiled (repeated) to fill a shape.

alignment.description: Alignment of the first tile within the shape

tx.description: Horizontal offset for the tile origin in EMUs (number) or UniversalMeasure.

ty.description: Vertical offset for the tile origin in EMUs (number) or UniversalMeasure.

amount.description: Amount in percentage points (0 to 100). Default 0.

numberFormat.description: Number format applied to the trendline label (c:numFmt formatCode).

UniversalMeasure.description: Measurement string: number followed by a unit (mm, cm, in, pt, pc, pi or px).

VariantValue.description: JS-level variant value carried by a vt:* element.

rId.description: Relationship ID to the published item

WorkbookExtensionOptions.description: One workbook-level ext element (uri-keyed raw content, round-trip).

content.description: Inner XML of the ext element.

namespaces.description: Namespace declarations carried on the ext element.

WorkbookOptions.description: Root options for a .xlsx package — maps to workbook.xml plus its satellite parts.

absPath.description: Workbook folder path (x15ac:absPath/@url in an mc:AlternateContent after workbookPr) — round-trip only.

borders.description: Borders section of xl/styles.xml, in source order — round-trip only.

calcChain.description: Calculation chain cells (xl/calcChain.xml) — set on parse; the compiler round-trips them verbatim and rebuilds from formula cells only when absent

cellStyleXfs.description: Named cell-style templates — definitions referenced by cellStyles

cellXfs.description: cellXfs section of xl/styles.xml, in source order — round-trip only.

chartsheets.description: Chart-only sheets (no cells, just a chart)

contentTypes.description: Content types from the source [Content_Types].xml (round-trip only). Present, generate() keeps the source Default/Override entries as the base declaration table and derives only what they leave uncovered.

created.description: Creation timestamp (W3CDTF), round-tripped from dcterms:created. null = the source core.xml carried none — emit nothing; undefined (fresh) = default to now.

customProperties.description: Custom properties (docProps/custom.xml); omitted from the package when empty

defaultNamespace.description: Emit the core-properties vocabulary as the default namespace — the ISO strict binding, where the source root is `<coreProperties xmlns=…>` and cp:-prefixed children appear prefix-less (dc:/dcterms: keep their prefixes). Round-trip only.

definedNames.description: Defined names — named ranges, constants, formulas

dxfs.description: Pre-defined differential formats for conditional formatting

encrypted.description: The source file is an encrypted OOXML package (OLE2/CFB container). Round-trip only: the plaintext needs the password, so the original bytes are carried verbatim and generate() re-emits them unchanged — every other field stays empty. Mixing sheet content is rejected — it would be silently dropped.

extensions.description: Trailing extension list (workbook > extLst > ext) — round-trip only.

fills.description: Fills section of xl/styles.xml, in source order — round-trip only.

fonts.description: Fonts section of xl/styles.xml, in source order — round-trip only. Present together with fills/borders/cellXfs, these adopt the parsed style table wholesale (cells keep raw style indices instead of resolved definitions, matching the source's own numbering).

identifier.description: Unique document identifier, round-tripped from dc:identifier.

modified.description: Last modified timestamp (W3CDTF); same null/undefined semantics as  {@link  created } .

numFmts.description: numFmts section of xl/styles.xml, in source order — round-trip only.

oleSize.description: OLE embedded range — workbook-level, after calcPr

passthroughRelationships.description: Relationships from rebuilt parts' source .rels that point at rawParts (e.g. workbook.xml → externalLink/pivotCache). Re-emitted verbatim — target unchanged (passthrough paths never move), fresh rId. Round-trip only.

pivotCacheRefs.description: Pivot cache references from workbook.xml — parse-only round-trip wiring

pivotCaches.description: Pivot cache definitions — parse-only (CT-layer); compiler regenerates from sourceData

rawParts.description: Parts carried verbatim from the source that generate() does not rebuild (drawings, VML, external links, any unknown extension part). Collected wholesale by the core passthrough pipeline — everything the model did not absorb survives with bytes and content-type declaration intact. Parts the compiler happens to rebuild under the same path win over the passthrough copy (assembly order), so model-driven parts need no exclusion here.

sharedStrings.description: Shared string table (xl/sharedStrings.xml), in table order. Parse fills it so generate() can seed the write context from the source entries — cells referencing rich-text si values keep their structure and index instead of collapsing to flattened text. Fresh documents omit it and register strings from cell values as they stringify.

theme.description: Theme (xl/theme/theme1.xml) — structured round-trip; fresh default when omitted

version.description: Document version number, round-tripped from cp:version.

workbookPr.description: Workbook properties — includes defaultThemeVersion, which Excel requires when the package carries a theme (dropping it makes the file unopenable)

revisionsHashValue.description: Revisions modern encryption: base64-encoded hash value

revisionsSaltValue.description: Revisions modern encryption: base64-encoded salt value

workbookPassword.description: Plain-text password — legacy Excel hash computed automatically

autoTitleDeleted.description: Auto-generated title suppressed (c:autoTitleDeleted) — emitted only when set.

axes.description: Per-axis configuration. Omitted, the library emits sensible default axes derived from chart type; provided, each axis is serialized verbatim and parsed back, enabling full round-trip of gridlines/units/tick marks/etc.

axisIds.description: Axis references (c:axId sequence on the chart group) — round-trip. Normally derived from `axes`; kept when the source sequence differs (legacy Word writes a dangling `axId val="0"` for a missing third axis).

bandFormats.description: Surface chart color bands (c:bandFmts, after ser in surface charts).

bubbleScale.description: Bubble scale as percent of default size (c:bubbleScale).

categoryFormatCode.description: Category number format (c:numCache > c:formatCode, numeric categories).

categoryFormula.description: Category reference formula (c:cat > c:*Ref > c:f) — round-trip.

categoryLabels.description: Literal category labels, emitted as c:strLit (c:cat > c:strLit).

colorMappingOverride.description: Theme color mapping override (c:clrMapOvr, before c:chart).

creationId.description: a16:creationId `@id` from the cNvPr/docPr extension list — Office's per-object creation stamp, the sole known cNvPr ext content.

customSplitPoints.description: ofPie custom split point indices (c:custSplit > c:secondPiePt, with splitType "cust").

dataLabels.description: Chart-group-level data labels (c:dLbls after the ser elements).

date1904.description: 1904 date system (c:date1904) — emitted only when the source had it.

description.description: XSD `@descr` — alt text for accessibility; emitted only when present.

dialect.description: Namespace dialect of the chart part. A strict (ISO/IEC 29500 Strict, purl.oclc.org) source package rejects a chart re-serialized with transitional namespaces — parse records the dialect from the root element and stringify re-declares the matching namespace set.

ext.description: Raw inner XML of the chart-space trailing c:extLst (after userShapes — c14:pivotOptions' home). Round-trip only, same contract as series ext.

extentCx.description: Anchor extent width in EMU (oneCell/absoluteAnchor ext, default 400000).

extentCy.description: Anchor extent height in EMU (oneCell/absoluteAnchor ext, default 300000).

firstSliceAngle.description: Pie/doughnut first slice angle in degrees (c:firstSliceAng).

gapWidth.description: Bar/column gap width as percent of width (c:gapWidth).

grouping.description: Series grouping (c:grouping val). Absent → the per-type default the header always wrote (clustered for bar/column, standard for line/area).

hidden.description: XSD `@hidden` (default false); emitted as "1" only when true.

holeSize.description: Pie/doughnut doughnut hole size as percent (c:holeSize).

hyperlink.description: Click hyperlink on the chart frame itself (a:hlinkClick inside xdr:cNvPr).

lang.description: Chart UI language (c:lang, e.g. "en-US") — emitted only when set.

legendLayout.description: Legend manual layout (c:legend's c:layout) — true emits the bare `<c:layout/>` form, an object the manual layout.

legendPosition.description: Legend position (c:legendPos, defaults to "r" when legend is shown).

legendShapeProperties.description: Legend fill and outline (c:legend's c:spPr) — round-trip.

markers.description: Show line-chart markers (c:marker on c:lineChart, 2D only). Emitted only when set.

name.description: XSD `@name` (required in XML); API-optional, the descriptor synthesizes a fallback.

numericCategories.description: Categories are numeric (c:cat carries c:numRef/c:numCache instead of c:strRef/c:strCache). Numeric categories render on a value-formatted axis; parse sets this when the source used numRef.

ofPieType.description: ofPie variant: pie-of-pie or bar-of-pie (c:ofPieType, default "pie").

pivotFormats.description: Pivot chart per-series formats (c:pivotFmts, after autoTitleDeleted).

pivotSource.description: Pivot chart source (c:pivotSource, after clrMapOvr, before protection).

plotAreaShapeProperties.description: Plot-area fill and outline (c:plotArea's trailing c:spPr) — round-trip.

plotVisOnly.description: Plot visible cells only (c:plotVisOnly, defaults to true when omitted).

roundedCorners.description: Rounded chart-area corners (c:roundedCorners) — emitted only when set.

secondPieSize.description: ofPie second-pie size — number (5–200) or percent string (c:secondPieSize).

shape.description: 3D bar column shape (chart-group-level c:shape on c:bar3DChart).

shapeProperties.description: Chart-area shape properties (c:spPr after c:chart) — round-trip.

showDataLabelsOverMax.description: Show data labels over the chart maximum (c:showDLblsOverMax).

splitPosition.description: ofPie split position (c:splitPos, used with splitType pos/val).
